args:
tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
cat > "$tmpdir/airstack.toml" <<'TOML'
[project]
name = "regression"
deploy_mode = "remote"

[[infra.servers]]
name = "edge-1"
provider = "hetzner"
region = "nbg1"
server_type = "cpx11"
ssh_key = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub"

[services.frontend]
image = "nginx:latest"
ports = [80]

[edge]
provider = "caddy"
extra_include_file = "/opt/aria/Caddy.extra"

[[edge.sites]]
host = "downloads.example.com"
upstream_service = "frontend"
upstream_port = 80
tls_email = "ops@example.com"
redirect_http = true

[[edge.sites.static]]
path_prefix = "/downloads"
root = "/srv/downloads"
browse = false
host_path = "/srv/downloads"
headers = { Cache-Control = "public, max-age=300" }

[[edge.sites.routes]]
path_prefix = "/internal"
upstream = "frontend:8081"
strip_prefix = true
headers = { X-Edge-Route = "internal" }
TOML

cargo run -p airstack-core -- --config "$tmpdir/airstack.toml" edge plan >"$tmpdir/edge_plan.out"
grep -q "import /opt/aria/Caddy.extra" "$tmpdir/edge_plan.out"
grep -q "handle @static_0" "$tmpdir/edge_plan.out"
grep -q "reverse_proxy frontend:8081" "$tmpdir/edge_plan.out"
grep -q "reverse_proxy frontend:80" "$tmpdir/edge_plan.out"

tmpdir=$(mktemp -d)
cat > "$tmpdir/airstack.toml" <<'TOML'
[project]
name = "upload-regression"
deploy_mode = "remote"

[[infra.servers]]
name = "edge-1"
provider = "hetzner"
region = "nbg1"
server_type = "cpx11"
ssh_key = "~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub"
TOML

set +e
cargo run -p airstack-core -- --config "$tmpdir/airstack.toml" upload edge-1 "$tmpdir/does-not-exist.dmg" /srv/downloads/app.dmg >"$tmpdir/stdout.log" 2>"$tmpdir/stderr.log"
code=$?
set -e
test "$code" -ne 0
grep -q "Source file not found" "$tmpdir/stderr.log"

steps.msg: edge include/static rendering and upload validation paths are covered
